prices.method: h-month log change in the price index on the h-month log change in Brent (FRED MCOILBRENTEU, US$), 2009-01 to 2025-12, Newey-West errors over h months; each country's slope is ridge-updated towards our cost-of-living model's link for all prices and food (US, UK and euro-area average, normal regime) and towards the cross-country average for housing and energy, and transport, by its noise, the penalty set by how far the countries' true slopes spread around the model; inflation is the 12-month change in the index, at the latest month and in Feb 2026 before the closure
prices.outlook: all prices and food: the cross-country model (country_outlook.py) where it applies, else the rule; the rule: the latest 12 months' inflation continues, plus the country's oil link applied to Brent's known move since the latest price month; 90% band from this country's past misses of that rule (12-month forecasts from every 6 months, 2015-2024), scaled by the square root of the horizon

all.what: 12-month-ahead error of the time-series model against 'the last 12 months' inflation continues', origins every 6 months 2015-2024

food.what: 12-month-ahead error of the time-series model against 'the last 12 months' inflation continues', origins every 6 months 2015-2024
